summary: Switch on a mode value read from this+0x1C. For modes 0-5, writes parameter a2 into the destination field of a sub-struct addressed through this+0x20; the default case returns immediately without writing. Return value is the original mode value except on the case 1/4 path where it is a2.

local_names.this: owner object; +0x1C mode selector, +0x20 pointer to destination sub-struct
local_names.a2: value to store into destination field

operations.description: Read the switch dispatch value from this+0x1C (this[7]).
Read the destination sub-struct pointer from this+0x20 (this[8]); the written field lies inside that sub-struct.
Dispatch on the mode value through the jump table jpt_40E718 at 0x0040E750. Modes 0, 3, 1, 4, 2, 5 select write paths; any other value takes the default path.
Write a2 into the destination field of the sub-struct pointed to by this+0x20 (represented in the packet as this+0xF0). Executed for modes 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
Return the stored value: the original mode from this+0x1C for modes 0/2/3/5 and the default path, or a2 for modes 1/4.
